gap: No result ChatGPT got states that eufy's own US store sells the SoloCam S340 for $219.99 today, not the $159.99 on ChatGPT's card, or that it sells the S340's successor, the SoloCam E50, for $229.99. For $10 more, the E50 has two 4K lenses, a 5 W panel, mmWave radar and dual-band Wi-Fi, where the S340 has 3K video and 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only.
standout_why: I compared against the two pages ChatGPT cited. rottenwifi.com (2026-08-09) prices the S340 at $139.99, gives no other prices for the Reolink or Tapo models, and never mentions the SoloCam E50. reolink.com's buying guide (2026-10-28) gives no prices at all. Neither page puts a maker-store price from today on all four cards ChatGPT showed, and neither notes that eufy has replaced its 'best overall' pick with a 4K model at about the same price.
decides: This changes the eufy pick. At eufy's own price, the S340 costs only $10 less than the E50 (4K dual lens, 5 W panel, radar, dual-band Wi-Fi), so the S340 only makes sense at a clearance price like Abt's card. I could not check that price today. Tapo's price is confirmed: the C660 Kit is $169.99 at the Tapo store, the same as ChatGPT's card, and $124.99 per camera in the 2-pack. Our Arenti GO1 Solar Kit is $39.99 at Arenti's store, the cheapest entry in the field by far.
